description: List your brand's docs as a FLAT list (metadata only — no body). Complements content_docs_tree (which returns the hierarchy). Use this to discover a doc's UUID by title/status before fetching or mutating it via content_get_doc. Each item carries id, slug, full_path, title, status, parent_id, is_section, sort_order, seo_*, timestamps.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_list_docs
